stem.text: The number of people waiting in a line, measured in people, is modeled by a twice-differentiable function N of time t, measured in minutes. It is known that \( N''(4) = 4.5 \). Using correct units, interpret the meaning of \( N''(4) = 4.5 \) in the context of the problem.

answer_key.label: At time t = 4 minutes, the rate at which the number of people in the line is changing is increasing at a rate of 4.5 people per minute per minute.

worked_solution.text: \( N''(4) \) is the rate of change of \( N' \), the rate at which the number of people in the line changes, so it is measured in people per minute per minute.
worked_solution.rule_named: second derivative as the rate of change of a rate

worked_solution.text: The value is positive, so at t = 4 the rate of change of the number of people in the line is itself increasing, by 4.5 people per minute for each minute.
worked_solution.rule_named: sign of the second derivative gives the direction of change of the rate

options.derivation: the units of the first derivative given for a rate of a rate, one time unit short
